messages:
sophia_sales: kicking off thread — HelixMed POC needs MSA + DPA redlines and exec signature routing. Also flagged SLA targets (they asked for 99.9% availability and ~100ms latency for interactive demo). any precedents?
ben_legal: saw the redlines. main asks: EU data residency addendum, expanded subprocessor disclosure, breach notif 72h -> they want 24h. indemnity language widened. recommend we propose standard DPA + EU addendum and push back on indemnity scope.
raj_eng: technical note — 100ms p95 for gen is unrealistic on hosted for 16k context. For Dedicated we can get p95 ~250ms (small prompt), hosted p95 ~400ms typical. we can offer target tiers in the SLA (p95 latency buckets) and a throughput SLA for reserved capacity. Also: customer wants dedicated GPU isolation for compliance — acceptable for Dedicated only.
claudia_ps: pricing question from Helix: want committed capacity + per-token overage at a discounted rate. they asked for a PO with blended rate. we usually do a commit + overage pricing table. can draft an OF with placeholders. need expected monthly token volume from sales.
kevin_finance: net30 is standard but finance can approve net45 for preapproved enterprise deals. need PO number before countersign.
sophia_sales: Helix insists on exec signature on the OF and countersigned MSA (their procurement policy). who on our side can provide exec signoff if TCV > $400k?
ben_legal: legal can countersign after finance approval. exec signature recommended when > $500k TCV. if they insist earlier, we can escalate to VP Sales for signature but need business justification.
sophia_sales: they want DocuSign envelope routed through their SSO and template id helix-0ab12x. can we support that flow?
docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelopeId=env_98321, status=sent, recipients=[sophia_sales, ben_legal, finance:kevin_finance]. Link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/env_98321
claudia_ps: tagging ops — will this DocuSign flow trigger our intake for countersign? need to ensure legal sees redlines before final sign.
ben_legal: i'll prepare a redline of MSA + DPA with EU addendum and upload to the envelope. aim EOD.
raj_eng: i'll prepare a short SLA annex explaining latency/availability tiers and hardware requirements for Dedicated vs Hosted. will include suggested metrics (p95, p99, throughput) and a note about fallback to smaller context models for lower latency.
claudia_ps: i'll draft the order form with commit/overage tiers and a billing clause for PO + invoice. will include placeholder pricing: commit X, overage Y.
sophia_sales: action items summarized: ben -> MSA/DPA redline with EU addendum (EOD), raj -> SLA annex (tomorrow), claudia -> OF draft (tomorrow), kevin -> confirm net terms and PO routing, i'll coordinate DocuSign and request exec sign if needed.
kevin_finance: noted — will preapprove net45 if finance backup submitted, will provide PO number once buyer confirms.
sophia_sales: demo with Helix scheduled Thu 2pm CET. please flag anything blocking before then. i'll post doc links in thread. :calendar:
sophia_sales: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/contracts/MSA_v2.pdf, https://redwood.internal/docs/dpa/eu-addendum.pdf, demo deck: https://drive.redwood/helixmed/demo_v1.pdf
